## CoinorChronicles v2 — Draft for Review
**Nothing here publishes anything.** Each run drafts an episode, a second model call reviews it, and the draft is sent to you on Telegram. You post it yourself.

State (episode number, clan memory, gates/heavens) lives in this workflow's static data, so it only saves on *production* (active) runs, not manual test runs.

Activate only after you have read the checklist in n8n/README_V2.md.
